observations: Photo 0: the back of a black DSLR camera body held in a hand; 'Canon' printed below the rear screen is readable.

Visible controls: mode dial with lock on the top left, power switch, viewfinder with rubber eyecup, START/STOP button with live view lever, AF-ON label, rear quick control dial, a column of buttons left of the screen.
The rear screen is off, so nothing shows the camera powering on, menus or shutter count.
The front of the camera, the model badge, the lens mount and any lens are not shown.
No battery, charger or lens is in the photo.
Photo has a 'NOKIA | ZEISS' phone camera stamp and a Jiji watermark; it is a single low resolution shot.
Body looks intact from the back with no obvious cracks; normal light wear cannot be judged at this resolution.

read_from: photo 0 back, 'Canon' below the screen; model badge not shown

claims.claim: 18MP APS-C CMOS sensor, 8 frames per second, 1080p HD video
claims.evidence: These specs fit one Canon model, but the model badge on the front is not shown, so the model cannot be read off the camera.
No shutter count screenshot or EXIF readout shown.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No lens appears in the photo and it is unclear if one is included.
Neither battery nor charger is shown.
Repair history cannot be shown by photos.

risks.risk: The model is not the one the specs describe; the model sets the price.
risks.proof: Photo of the front of the body showing the model badge, with a handwritten code and date in shot.
risks.if_unproven: held; not priced until the model is readable

risks.risk: Camera does not power on, shutter or autofocus faulty.
risks.proof: Clip of the camera switching on and taking several shots, with the code in shot.

risks.risk: High shutter count shortening remaining shutter life.
risks.proof: Screenshot of a shutter count tool reading the camera's serial, or EXIF of a fresh photo.

risks.risk: No lens included, or lens has fungus or scratches.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens front and rear elements against light, and seller confirmation of what is included.

risks.risk: Battery and charger missing or non-original.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger with labels readable.
risks.if_unproven: as body without battery and charger

risks.proof: Photo of the serial number under the body next to the code, matching the shutter count screenshot.
risks.if_unproven: treated as unproven ownership; agent checks serial on inspection

proof_requests: Photo of the front of the camera with the model badge readable and a handwritten code and today's date in shot.
Clip of the camera powering on and taking shots, rear screen visible.
Shutter count screenshot tied to the body serial number.
Photo of the lens (front and rear glass), battery and charger, and a list of what is included.
Photo of the serial number plate under the body.
response.reason: Only the brand Canon is readable on the back of the body; the model badge that sets the price is not shown, and the seller's specs alone are not proof of model. A front photo with the model badge would allow pricing as body only and not working until a power-on clip is shown.
